decisions.statement: A line is appended rather than written over.
A line names the phase its run was judged at.
A line has the cost of the child processes a check waited on.
Memory is read as the high-water mark the run moved.
A file's fill is read from its size rather than from its text.
Entries are kept outside the commit.
No page states its own entries.
Nothing here judges a run's cost.
A run that cannot be recorded is not a run that is refused.

definition: what one run cost, one line appended as that run ends
